title: Areteion
description:
Areteion is a collectible card game that plays like a strategy game. Cards go onto a map, where they farm, hunt, sail, build and fight. A game takes about 15 minutes.

Twelve Olympians who each play differently. Demeter farms, Artemis hunts, Poseidon sails, Ares goes to war, and eight more have their own ways. A deck takes one god or two.

A map full of myth. Barbarian camps, pirate hideouts, the Lernaean Hydra, the Minotaur, and encounters like the Trojan Horse and Circe.

Favor with Olympus. From the fifth round the gods alternate blessings and curses. Favor pays for the blessing, or pays off the curse.

Journeys or single games. Five games in a row with a deck that changes after every one, or a single game. Alone against a score, against the AI, or online against friends and strangers.

600+ cards, and more coming.

20 updates since launch, and development continues.
description_short: A CCG that plays like a strategy game. Twelve Olympians who each play differently. 600+ cards, single games or five-game journeys, played alone, against the AI, or online.
